findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "TURN UP THE MASALA" → 3 lines (4 words, 121px); "HOW MUCH FIRE CAN YOU TAKE?" → 3 lines (6 words, 92.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "01"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Mild", "Medium", "Hot", "Inferno").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 4 gradient fill(s): div.sunburst → repeating-conic-gradient(rgb(224, 58, 47) 0deg, rgb(224, 58, 47) 6deg, rgb(188, 49, 39) 6deg, rgb(188, 49, 39) | div.heat-stage → radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%, color(srgb 0.231961 0.329804 0.132745), rgb(18, 11, 5) 72%) | div.zig → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255, 243, 220) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%), linear-gradient(225deg, rgb(255, 243, 2
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 110 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: p.hero-note → rgb(26, 18, 8) 5px 5px 0px 0px | a.btn.btn-yellow → rgb(26, 18, 8) 5px 5px 0px 0px | a.btn → rgb(26, 18, 8) 5px 5px 0px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fff3dc, section #fff3dc, text #fff3dc).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "100g" 2.1:1 (#1a1208 on #6b2d8b); "Hand-ground. Zero fillers." 2.5:1 (#fff3dc on #2ba8e0); "Fresh batch every week" 2.5:1 (#fff3dc on #2ba8e0); "Single-origin, farm named" 2.5:1 (#fff3dc on #2ba8e0)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 4 typefaces in use (Baloo 2, Bowlby One, Rubik Dirt, Caveat Brush).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 34 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (66px, 94px, 1065px, 78px, 407px, 736px, 218px); the three most used hold only 24% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "TURN UP" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "THE" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "MASALA" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "100% real spices" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 12 screens in a row: "YOUR DABBA (0)"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "TURN UP THE MASALA" → 3 lines (4 words, 64.5px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "FSSAILABTESTED" above "TURN UP THE MASALA"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "spice-o-meter 3000" (15px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
